text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). More than just a 
goal race, this is the big moment she has 
dedicated to her father.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fans cheered with all their hearts for 
Tamamo Cross, who ran for the sake of her 
family. Deeply moved by the warmth of the 
world, she stepped up to face the race.
